## About the author

Zuboff, S. and Maxmin, J. (2002). The Support Economy: Why corporations are failing individuals and the next episode of capitalism, New York, NY: Viking Penguin.

Shoshana Zuboff is the Charles Edward Wilson Professor of Business Administration (Emerita) and a Faculty Associate at the Berkman Center for Internet and Society, Harvard Law School. She is currently completing a new book, Master or Slave? The Fight for the Soul of Our Information Civilization (forthcoming, Public Affairs and Eichborn 2016). She is also the author of In the Age of the Smart Machine: The future of work and power and The Support Economy: Why corporations are failing individuals and the next episode of capitalism.
